column3: The home part carries automations.touched {id: revision} (in memory, set by each change), and the history page reloads automation.get only when its own entry moves
column4: The list has no per-automation revision, and a run start or finish doesn't move updatedAt, so comparing updatedAt would miss runs. The map costs no reads or writes; after a reboot an entry is absent until it changes, which reads as 0 and reloads once
